name: Analog
note: Abu Dhabi edge-computing company launched by G42 in January 2024; founder Alex Kipman says G42 is its biggest investor (claim analog-g42-venture). On the shoulders of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG kit; also an official technology sponsor of UAE Team L'IMAD. The state link runs through G42: Mubadala (Abu Dhabi state fund) holds a minority stake there with a board seat.
